---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
format: html
author: Isabella Thaxton
execute:
  echo: false
---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median household income by Texas county",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    percent_bachelors_or_higher =
      sum(estimate[variable %in% c("bachelors", "masters", "professional", "doctorate")]) /
      first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_or_higher),
    y = percent_bachelors_or_higher
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "deeppink") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's Degree Attainment by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "deeppink4"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "deeppink4")
  )
```

```{r}
age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      dense_rank(desc(population)) <= 5,
      NAME,
      NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age, color = median_age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Median age") +
  labs(
    title = "County Population and Median Age in California",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
